svg.title: Nsc-Unity — UML Class Diagram
svg.desc: Selected current gameplay classes. All class boxes show attributes and operations. Actual source names and relationships; not a proposed refactor.

g.title: PlayerHandMovement <|-- PlayerHandCombat — class PlayerHandCombat : PlayerHandMovement
HandItemHolder *-- HeldItem — Hold instantiates heldPrefab below holdPoint; ClearCurrent destroys Current.gameObject
HeldItem <|-- ChargeGunHeldItem — class ChargeGunHeldItem : HeldItem
HeldItem <|-- GunHeldItem — class GunHeldItem : HeldItem
HeldItem <|-- SwordHeldItem — class SwordHeldItem : HeldItem
IHittable <|.. RobotHealth — RobotHealth : NetworkBehaviour, IHittable
TorsoMovement <--> PlayerFootForRobot — _attachedFeet; PlayerFootForRobot.torso
PlayerLegCombat --> PlayerFootForRobot — private PlayerFootForRobot footController
PlayerLegCombat --> RobotHealth — private RobotHealth legHealth
RespawnManager --> PlayerHandMovement — private PlayerHandMovement[] hands
ItemPickupInteractor --> WorldItem — WorldItem Focused; RequestPickup(WorldItem)
PlayerInventory --> HandItemHolder — RefreshHandFromEquipped calls hand.Hold(EquippedItem)
ItemDatabase --> ItemDefinition — private List<ItemDefinition> items
ItemWheelUI --> PlayerInventory — inventory.OnSlotsChanged += RefreshSlots; inventory.OnEquippedChanged += HandleEquippedChanged
PickupPromptUI --> ItemPickupInteractor — interactor.OnFocusChanged += HandleFocusChanged
EnemyController <--> EnemyCombat — EnemyController.combat; EnemyCombat.controller
EnemyHealth ..> GameFlowManager — ServerDie calls GameFlowManager.Instance.TriggerVictory()
GunHeldItem ..> IHittable — GetComponentInParent<IHittable>(); hittable.ServerTakeDamage(...)
RespawnManager --> TorsoMovement — private TorsoMovement torsoMovement
RobotHealth --> JointPullAndReconnect — Jpar; OnConnectionStateChanged += OnPartConnectionChanged
EnemyHealth --> EnemyController — private EnemyController controller
EnemyCombat ..> IHittable — ProcessHitDetection calls ServerTakeDamage
ItemPickupInteractor --> PlayerInventory — private PlayerInventory inventory; TryAddServerSide
PlayerInventory --> ItemDatabase — private ItemDatabase itemDatabase
HandItemHolder ..> ChargeGunHeldItem — serverChargingGun; CancelCharge; ExecuteFire
TorsoMovement <--> PlayerHandMovement — _attachedHands; PlayerHandMovement.torso
RespawnManager --> PlayerFootForRobot — private PlayerFootForRobot[] feet
HeldItem --> ItemDefinition — public ItemDefinition Definition { get; private set; }
WorldItem --> ItemDefinition — private ItemDefinition definition
GunHeldItem ..> EnemyHealth — GetComponentInParent<EnemyHealth>(); enemyHealth.ServerTakeHit(...)
PvpTeamManager ..> PvpRobotTeam — PvpRobotTeam.FindByTeam(team); robot.ServerResetDefeat()
PvpRobotTeam ..> PvpTeamManager — PvpTeamManager.Instance.ServerReportDefeat(team)
PvpRobotTeam --> RobotHealth — private readonly List<RobotHealth> _limbHealths

svg.text: + public − private # protected | Solid line + hollow triangle: inheritance · Dashed line + hollow triangle: interface · Diamond: owned lifetime
Base types shown after “:”. Selected members and dependencies only. Shared references are not composition. Not every class in the project is shown.
